neighbours.label: the token ' every' (as in 'every time', 'every single day'); the + pole is ' single'
fire: The old dog waits by the door every evening for her owner.
I hear the same song on the radio every time I get in the car.
He practised the piano every single day for ten years.
Nurses on the night shift check the patients every hour.
Our team scores a goal almost every time we play them.
She writes a page in her diary every night before bed.
The bus to the airport leaves every twenty minutes.
My grandfather swam in the lake every summer of his life.
quiet: The old dog waits by the door each evening for her owner.
I hear the same song on the radio whenever I get in the car.
He practised the piano for hours a day for ten years.
Nurses on the night shift check the patients hourly.
Our team usually scores a goal when we play them.
She writes a page in her diary at night before bed.
The bus to the airport leaves twice an hour.
My grandfather swam in the lake each summer of his life.
